html:
Perks › Epic

Echo Chamber

Epic perk · Scoring bonus

On a scoring play, repeat your previous perk bonus.

In-game card text

How it works

On a scoring play, Echo Chamber adds your most recent perk bonus again, once for each copy.

  • "Most recent" means the last bonus line added on your previous play that had one, after Midas Touch doubling. It can come from an earlier hand in the same match.
  • When Echo Chamber fires, the echo itself becomes your most recent bonus. With two or more copies the echo grows from play to play.
  • Nothing is repeated until you have earned at least one perk bonus.

At a glance

RarityEpic
TypeScoring bonus
Needs a scoring playYes. It only fires when the open-end total is a positive multiple of 5.
How to get itUnlock it in the Perks compendium for 900 Bone Bucks once you own 5 Rare perks.
